answer: A vertex of per-task receipts records who did what, and the summit of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on invitation quota tree, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. What survives to the vault is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
